source_snapshot.procedure: Boot approved USB installation media, install OS, inspect event logs, then perform warm reboot, cold reboot and AC cycle, checking logs after each and repeating the three-cycle sequence three times after installation.
source_snapshot.criteria: OS installs successfully; system remains workable after reboot; no unexplained error/fail/warning events except RD-approved known events.
source_snapshot.script: Three private project repositories for warm reboot, DC/cold cycle and AC cycle counts. Thirty minutes attended and thirty machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL with owner-provided OS image, partitioning and credentials; unattended installation can be automated but is destructive and requires target-disk confirmation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with exact image/hash, disk and configuration, full installer evidence, three warm/cold/AC repetitions, per-cycle event review and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies the package/approval split and disk-wipe risk but omits the source's complete three-mode, three-repetition cycle and event-log matrix.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the hybrid classification and restores the omitted cycle/log coverage with identity and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 559 is the distinct row-382 SEL view-and-clear case; its erase-on-next-reset workflow does not apply to OS installation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Keeps installation and cycling as one source workflow while assigning destructive target approval and physical/power controls to engineers and automatable installer/log collection to the agent.

original_test_intent: Install the approved OS on the exact authorized disk, prove it boots and remains usable, then validate three repetitions of warm, cold and AC recovery with event logs free of unexplained errors.
original_method: Validate image, disk, install configuration, backup and recovery; install from approved USB/virtual media; capture full installer and first-boot evidence; then execute the approved warm/cold/AC sequence three times with per-step boot, control and event evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must authorize the destructive target and supervise boot-media, console and physical/power transitions; the agent may run an approved unattended installer and collect complete per-cycle system/BMC evidence.
required_inputs: Signed OS image/version/hash and unattended or operator install configuration
Target disk, partition, encryption, credentials and network plan
Warm/cold/AC definitions, three-repeat matrix and RD-known-event list
safety_requirements: Never guess the disk or partition plan
Verify image integrity and target identity before write
Never AC-cycle during installation or active filesystem writes
Preserve logs before any optional clear
Stop on wrong target, failed boot, unexplained event or lost telemetry
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Perform read-only identity, storage, image and recovery checks
Run only the approved unattended installation after confirmation
Collect complete installer, boot, OS, BMC, SEL and cycle-controller evidence
Correlate every warm/cold/AC iteration and known-event classification
engineer_actions: Supervise boot-media and any manual installer step
Authorize and supervise all warm/cold/AC transitions
Classify exceptions with RD and own final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally correct for unattended installation but incomplete because it lacks the exact source cycle matrix, per-cycle logs and PDU/BMC recovery controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-approved unattended/manual installer and the reviewed pinned project cycle tools; do not invent disk, boot-order or power-control commands.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: USB installation, event checks, warm/cold/AC sequence, three repetitions and 30/30-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Assign immutable IDs to image, target disk, installed state and each of nine cycle checkpoints, retaining control status, boot timing and complete event deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic identity, no-write guards, cycle traceability and evidence retention.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; all three cycle types and three repetitions remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS installation is destructive and an AC cycle requires trustworthy power-state and filesystem-quiescence evidence.

project_override_considerations: Any project reduction in cycle count or substitution of virtual media for USB must be explicitly approved and reported as reduced coverage; it cannot be presented as the full master workflow.
expected_evidence: Approved partition/credential/network plan, backup and recovery
Complete installer and first-boot logs with final OS identity and storage layout
For each of nine transitions: control command/action, power/boot timestamps and console reachability
Complete per-step OS/BMC/SEL/event deltas with RD exception disposition
Final usable OS and approved power/configuration state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1481 consistently defines installation plus recovery cycles. Duplicate row 382 is isolated by row/hash/variant and its SEL erase workflow remains separate.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Image, disk plan, controls, event policy and recovery are finite project inputs; their absence requires package/confirmation rather than a permanent semantic block.

review_improvement: Prevents duplicate-code contamination and expands a generic unattended-install proposal into the source-required nine-transition recovery and event-evidence matrix.
independent_technical_reasoning: The destructive install target and power operations demand explicit engineer control, while unattended installation and evidence collection can be automated once inputs are fixed. REQUIRES accurately captures this hybrid workflow.
